info.title: Synapse Enterprise Intelligence API
info.description: Graphiti-backed temporal knowledge graph platform. Ingests enterprise documents, extracts a closed-vocabulary ontology, resolves entities, and maintains bi-temporal fact validity.

post.description:
Accept a document and queue it for processing.

R8: only the advertised size cap and extension allow-list are enforced. The
client enforces neither, and no content-level defence against hostile files
is implemented.

schema.title: Response Upload Api V1 Uploads Post

post.description:
Re-run every document for a source through the pipeline.

A replay is a genuine test of the pre-ingest filter: identical content should
be dropped as duplicates rather than duplicating the graph.

API because `MismatchItem` in ObservabilityScreen declares them that way.
